purpose: Authoritative source catalog recording DOIs, versions, licenses, and verified metadata for external validation benchmarks.

datasets.name: Tomato Multi-Sector Precision Irrigation Dataset
datasets.intended_scope: Soil-moisture forecasting and irrigation telemetry benchmarking

datasets.name: Leaf Wetness and Agrometeorological Dataset
datasets.intended_scope: Site-level nocturnal leaf-wetness duration and weather-risk evaluation
datasets.timestamp_handling: Verified UTC from archive README.md ('All date and time are reported in UTC') and ISO 8601 'Z' suffix. Nocturnal 18:00–06:00 UTC window enforced. Calibrated sensor benchmark threshold established as 50.0% in Filipescu et al. (2024, IEEE Trans. AgriFood Electronics, DOI: 10.1109/TAFE.2024.3401252); 20.0% evaluated as research-selected sensitivity threshold for comparative protocol analysis. Candidate Node A selection (Site 2) is invariant across both thresholds.

datasets.name: Libelium Olive Grove Multi-Sensor Dataset
datasets.intended_scope: Two-node telemetry quality, gaps and spatial disagreement

runtime_provenance: After running all three dataset validators, preserve results/real_data_validation/DATASETS_MANIFEST.json. That generated manifest contains exact input file paths, sizes, SHA-256 checksums, mappings and run parameters.
